title: Planta Plant Care Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(plant_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Planta plant care event events land each day and how many distinct plant name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Planta plant care event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct plant name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Planta plant care event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
